name: Boots of Speed
description: As a free action, the wearer can click her heels together to gain the benefits of haste for up to 10 rounds per day.

name: Boots of Striding and Springing
description: These boots increase the wearer's base land speed by 10 feet. In addition, the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump.

name: Ring of Invisibility
description: By activating this simple silver ring, the wearer can benefit from invisibility, as the spell.

name: Ring of Freedom of Movement
description: This ring allows the wearer to act as if continually under the effect of a freedom of movement spell.

name: Ring of Feather Falling
description: This ring is crafted with a feather pattern. It acts exactly like a feather fall spell, activated immediately should the wearer fall more than 5 feet.

name: Ring of Evasion
description: This ring continually grants the wearer the evasion ability. If the wearer already has evasion, she gains no additional benefit.

name: Eyes of the Eagle
description: These lenses grant a +5 competence bonus on Perception checks.

name: Goggles of Night
description: The lenses of this item grant darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: These gauntlets grant the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength.

name: Helm of Telepathy
description: The wearer can use detect thoughts at will and send a telepathic message or suggestion once per day.

name: Handy Haversack
description: A magical backpack that holds up to 80 lbs of items, always weighing only 5 lbs.
